summary: Family of 3 visiting from New York rescued after their truck was swept away by spring-runoff water in Escalante Creek; all reached higher ground before the truck submerged, and swiftwater rescue swimmers brought two members stranded on the far bank back across 4-5 feet of fast water
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue
notes: MCSO CrimeWatch SAR release (mined 2026-09-11, run 28). Family stranded overnight by rising waters; swimmers also recovered the submerged truck.
